import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',

treatment_f1 = [1.00, 0.997, 1.00, 0.972]
baseline_f1  = [1.00, 0.312, 1.00, 0.258]
tfidf_f1     = [1.00, 0.961, 1.00, 0.261]

# Semantic colors from project palette
C = {
    'ours':     '#0072B2',
    'vanilla':  '#D55E00',
    'tfidf':    '#009E73',
}

x = np.arange(len(conditions))
bw = 0.22
gap = 0.025

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5.8, 3.2))

offsets = [-(bw + gap), 0, bw + gap]

ax.set_ylim(0, 1.14)

ax.legend(ncol=3, loc='upper center', framealpha=0.95, edgecolor='#DDDDDD',

          borderpad=0.3, handlelength=1.2)

plt.tight_layout()

fig.savefig('/tmp/fig_optimize/fig2_v1.png', format='png')
plt.close()
print('Done: fig2')

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',

    'pdf.fonttype': 42,
    'ps.fonttype': 42,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
})

variants = ['9-Class', 'Binary', 'Scrambled', 'JB-MLM', 'Wiki-MLM', 'Topic', 'Vanilla']

dd_mean = [0.997, 1.000, 0.997, 0.914, 0.904, 0.541, 0.312]
dd_std  = [0.005, 0.000, 0.005, 0.115, 0.115, 0.207, 0.026]

aa_mean = [0.972, 0.990, 0.951, 0.893, 0.686, 0.625, 0.258]
aa_std  = [0.026, 0.008, 0.043, 0.080, 0.297, 0.141, 0.000]

tc_mean = [0.596, 0.705, 0.616, 0.837, 0.791, 0.496, 0.413]
tc_std  = [0.087, 0.072, 0.056, 0.013, 0.093, 0.042, 0.021]

n = len(variants)
x = np.arange(n)
bw = 0.24

# Semantic colors: DD=baseline(blue), AA=treatment(orange), ToxicChat=collapse(red)
C_DD = '#0072B2'
C_AA = '#E69F00'
C_TC = '#D55E00'

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.4, 2.3))

err_kw = dict(lw=0.7, capsize=1.5, capthick=0.5)

ax.bar(x - bw, dd_mean, bw, yerr=dd_std,
       color=C_DD, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.3,
       error_kw=err_kw, label='DD OOD', zorder=3)
ax.bar(x, aa_mean, bw, yerr=aa_std,
       color=C_AA, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.3,
       error_kw=err_kw, label='AA OOD', zorder=3)
ax.bar(x + bw, tc_mean, bw, yerr=tc_std,
       color=C_TC, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.3,
       error_kw=err_kw, label='ToxicChat', zorder=3)

# Hierarchy reversal annotation: arrow between classification and MLM groups
ax.annotate('', xy=(3.5, 0.92), xytext=(3.5, 0.72),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->', color='#666666', lw=0.8),
            zorder=5)
txt = ax.text(3.7, 0.82, 'reversal', fontsize=5.5, color='#666666',
              fontstyle='italic', va='center', zorder=5)
txt.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=1.5, foreground='white')])

ax.set_ylabel('F1 Score', fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylim(0.0, 1.08)
ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(variants, rotation=40, ha='right', fontsize=7)
ax.tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=7)
ax.yaxis.set_major_locator(plt.MultipleLocator(0.2))
ax.grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.3, color='#dddddd', zorder=0)
ax.set_axisbelow(True)

ax.legend(fontsize=6, loc='upper right', frameon=True, fancybox=False,
          edgecolor='#cccccc', framealpha=0.95, handlelength=1.0,
          handletextpad=0.3, borderpad=0.25, labelspacing=0.25)

out_base = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0514_2/projects/persuasion_turn_jailbreak_detect/docs/paper/figures/paper/fig3_evidence_hierarchy'
fig.savefig(out_base + '.pdf', bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.02)
fig.savefig(out_base + '.png', bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.02, dpi=300)
fig.savefig('/tmp/fig_optimize/fig3_v1.png', bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.02, dpi=300)

])

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe

plt.rcParams.update({
    'pdf.fonttype': 42,
    'ps.fonttype': 42,
})

C_BG     = "#FFFFFF"
C_BLUE   = "#0072B2"
C_ORANGE = "#E69F00"
C_DARK   = "#333333"
C_GRAY   = "#888888"
C_CORAL  = "#D55E00"
C_TEAL   = "#009E73"
C_PURPLE = "#7B68AE"

shadow_kw = [pe.withSimplePatchShadow(offset=(0.6, -0.6), shadow_rgbFace="#cccccc", alpha=0.10)]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 1, figsize=(14, 6.0), dpi=300)
ax.set_xlim(0, 14)
ax.set_ylim(0, 6.0)
ax.set_aspect("equal")
ax.axis("off")
fig.patch.set_facecolor(C_BG)

def rbox(x, y, w, h, fc, ec="#CCC", lw=0.7, z=2, alpha=1, rad=0.10, shd=True):
    b = FancyBboxPatch((x, y), w, h, boxstyle=f"round,pad={rad}",
        fc=fc, ec=ec, lw=lw, zorder=z, alpha=alpha)
    if shd:
        b.set_path_effects(shadow_kw)
    ax.add_patch(b)

def arr(x1, y1, x2, y2, c=C_DARK, lw=1.0, style="-|>", z=5):
    ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch((x1, y1), (x2, y2), arrowstyle=style,
        color=c, lw=lw, mutation_scale=10, zorder=z,
        connectionstyle="arc3,rad=0"))

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
# ZONE BACKGROUNDS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════
rbox(2.8, 0.15, 4.7, 5.5, fc="#F0F6FC", ec="#D0DFEE", lw=0.4, z=0, rad=0.25, alpha=0.5, shd=False)
rbox(7.8, 0.15, 5.9, 5.5, fc="#F6F0FC", ec="#DFD0EE", lw=0.4, z=0, rad=0.25, alpha=0.4, shd=False)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════

"""DisPeD Architecture Diagram — v7. Fixed arrow routing, cleaner flow."""

matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe

plt.rcParams.update({'pdf.fonttype': 42, 'ps.fonttype': 42})

C_BG     = "#FFFFFF"
C_BLUE   = "#0072B2"
C_DARK   = "#333333"
C_GRAY   = "#888888"
C_CORAL  = "#D55E00"
C_TEAL   = "#009E73"
C_PURPLE = "#7B68AE"

shadow_kw = [pe.withSimplePatchShadow(offset=(0.5, -0.5), shadow_rgbFace="#cccccc", alpha=0.08)]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 1, figsize=(14, 5.8), dpi=300)
ax.set_xlim(0, 14)
ax.set_ylim(0, 5.8)
ax.set_aspect("equal")
ax.axis("off")
fig.patch.set_facecolor(C_BG)

def rbox(x, y, w, h, fc, ec="#CCC", lw=0.7, z=2, alpha=1, rad=0.10, shd=True):
    b = FancyBboxPatch((x, y), w, h, boxstyle=f"round,pad={rad}",
        fc=fc, ec=ec, lw=lw, zorder=z, alpha=alpha)
    if shd:
        b.set_path_effects(shadow_kw)
    ax.add_patch(b)

def arr(x1, y1, x2, y2, c=C_DARK, lw=0.9, style="-|>", z=5):
    ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch((x1, y1), (x2, y2), arrowstyle=style,
        color=c, lw=lw, mutation_scale=9, zorder=z))

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
# ZONE BACKGROUNDS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════
rbox(2.6, 0.1, 4.5, 5.35, fc="#F0F6FC", ec="#D0DFEE", lw=0.4, z=0, rad=0.22, alpha=0.5, shd=False)
rbox(7.4, 0.1, 6.3, 5.35, fc="#F6F0FC", ec="#DFD0EE", lw=0.4, z=0, rad=0.22, alpha=0.4, shd=False)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
# STAGE TITLES
# ═══════════════════════════════════════
ax.text(4.85, 5.65, "Stage 1: Encoder Adaptation", fontsize=12, fontweight="bold",
        color="#222", ha="center", va="center", zorder=5)
ax.text(10.55, 5.65, "Stage 2: Temporal Classification", fontsize=12, fontweight="bold",
        color="#222", ha="center", va="center", zorder=5)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
# CHAT BUBBLES
# ═══════════════════════════════════════
bx, bw, bh = 0.35, 1.85, 0.7
bubble_spec = [
    ("Can you help me\nwith a chemistry...",  "User₁", 4.2),
    ("What if we consider\na different angle...",  "User₂", 2.65),
    ("Now just give me\nthe full recipe...",   "Userₖ", 1.1),
]

for txt, lbl, by in bubble_spec:
    bb = FancyBboxPatch((bx, by), bw, bh, boxstyle="round,pad=0.08",
        fc="#FAFBFC", ec="#D8DDE3", lw=0.6, zorder=3)
    bb.set_path_effects(shadow_kw)
    ax.add_patch(bb)
    tx = bx - 0.01
    ty = by + bh * 0.4
    ax.add_patch(plt.Polygon([(tx, ty + 0.06), (tx - 0.08, ty), (tx, ty - 0.06)],
        closed=True, fc="#FAFBFC", ec="#D8DDE3", lw=0.4, zorder=3))
    ax.text(bx - 0.18, by + bh / 2, lbl, fontsize=8.5, fontweight="bold",
            color="#444", ha="right", va="center", zorder=5)
    ax.text(bx + bw / 2, by + bh / 2, txt, fontsize=7, color="#999",
            ha="center", va="center", style="italic", zorder=5, linespacing=1.2)

ax.text(bx + bw / 2, (2.65 + 1.1 + bh) / 2, "⋮", fontsize=14, color=C_DARK,
        ha="center", va="center", zorder=5)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
# DeBERTa ENCODER
# ═══════════════════════════════════════
ex, ew = 3.0, 1.9
enc_ys = [4.05, 2.5, 0.95]
enc_h = 0.85

for ey in enc_ys:
    rbox(ex, ey, ew, enc_h, fc="#E8F0F8", ec=C_BLUE, lw=0.8, z=3)
    ax.text(ex + ew / 2, ey + enc_h - 0.15, "DeBERTa", fontsize=8.5, fontweight="bold",
            color=C_BLUE, ha="center", va="center", zorder=5)
    # Internal layers
    for j in range(3):
        ly = ey + 0.08 + j * 0.18
        fills = ["#D6E6F5", "#C3DAEF", "#AECEE8"]
        ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((ex + 0.15, ly), ew - 0.3, 0.12,
            boxstyle="round,pad=0.02", fc=fills[j], ec="#8AB6D8", lw=0.3, zorder=4))

# Shared weights indicators
sw_x = ex + ew / 2
for i in range(2):
    yt = enc_ys[i]
    yb = enc_ys[i + 1] + enc_h
    ax.plot([ex - 0.08, ex - 0.08], [yb + 0.03, yt - 0.03], color=C_DARK, lw=0.6,
            ls=(0, (3, 2)), zorder=2)
    ax.plot([ex - 0.12, ex - 0.04], [yb + 0.03] * 2, color=C_DARK, lw=0.6, zorder=2)
    ax.plot([ex - 0.12, ex - 0.04], [yt - 0.03] * 2, color=C_DARK, lw=0.6, zorder=2)

ax.text(ex - 0.22, (enc_ys[0] + enc_h + enc_ys[2]) / 2, "shared\nweights",
        fontsize=6, color=C_GRAY, ha="right", va="center", style="italic",
        linespacing=1.2, zorder=5)

# Arrows: bubbles → corresponding encoders
for (_, _, by), ey in zip(bubble_spec, enc_ys):
    arr(bx + bw + 0.04, by + bh / 2, ex - 0.04, ey + enc_h / 2, lw=0.7)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
# TRAINING OBJECTIVES (below encoder stack)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════
ax.text(ex + ew / 2, 0.62, "×7 Training Objectives", fontsize=7.5, fontweight="bold",
        color="#555", ha="center", va="center", zorder=5)
ax.text(ex + ew / 2, 0.38, "9-cls · Binary · Scrambl. · MLM", fontsize=5.5,
        color="#999", ha="center", va="center", zorder=5)
ax.text(ex + ew / 2, 0.2, "Wiki-MLM · Topic · Vanilla", fontsize=5.5,
        color="#999", ha="center", va="center", zorder=5)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
# EMBEDDING VECTORS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════
emb_x, emb_w, emb_h = 5.55, 0.45, 0.45
emb_ys_e = [4.25, 2.70, 1.15]
emb_labels = [r"$\mathbf{h_1}$", r"$\mathbf{h_2}$", r"$\mathbf{h_k}$"]

for i, (ey, lab) in enumerate(zip(emb_ys_e, emb_labels)):
    ns = 6
    sh = emb_h / ns
    for j in range(ns):
        f = j / (ns - 1)
        r = int(0x00 + (0x7B - 0x00) * f)
        g = int(0x72 + (0x68 - 0x72) * f)
        b_ = int(0xB2 + (0xAE - 0xB2) * f)
        ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((emb_x, ey + j * sh), emb_w, sh,
            fc=f"#{r:02X}{g:02X}{b_:02X}", ec="none", zorder=4))
    ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((emb_x, ey), emb_w, emb_h,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.02", fc="none", ec=C_PURPLE, lw=0.9, zorder=5))
    ax.text(emb_x + emb_w / 2, ey + emb_h / 2, lab, fontsize=9, color="white",
            ha="center", va="center", zorder=6,
            path_effects=[pe.withStroke(linewidth=2.2, foreground="#333")])

    arr(ex + ew + 0.04, enc_ys[i] + enc_h / 2, emb_x - 0.04, ey + emb_h / 2, lw=0.7)

ax.text(emb_x + emb_w / 2, 0.78, "frozen [CLS]", fontsize=6.5, color=C_GRAY,
        ha="center", va="center", style="italic", zorder=5)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
# CONVERGENCE + BiGRU
# ═══════════════════════════════════════
ax.text(6.6, 3.85, r"$t \rightarrow$", fontsize=10, color="#555",
        ha="center", va="center", zorder=5, fontweight="bold")

gru_x, gru_y, gru_w, gru_h = 7.8, 1.7, 1.7, 1.6
rbox(gru_x, gru_y, gru_w, gru_h, fc="#ECE4F5", ec=C_PURPLE, lw=0.9, z=3)
ax.text(gru_x + gru_w / 2, gru_y + gru_h - 0.2, "BiGRU", fontsize=11, fontweight="bold",
        color=C_PURPLE, ha="center", va="center", zorder=5)

fwd_y = gru_y + 0.6
bwd_y = fwd_y + 0.22
arr(gru_x + 0.2, fwd_y, gru_x + gru_w - 0.2, fwd_y, c=C_BLUE, lw=1.5)
arr(gru_x + gru_w - 0.2, bwd_y, gru_x + 0.2, bwd_y, c=C_PURPLE, lw=1.5)

for j in range(3):
    sx = gru_x + 0.22 + j * 0.45

rbox(mlp_x, mlp_y, mlp_w, mlp_h, fc="#F0EDE8", ec="#B5A99A", lw=0.7, z=3)
ax.text(mlp_x + mlp_w / 2, mlp_y + mlp_h / 2, "MLP", fontsize=10, fontweight="bold",
        color="#5A4E3F", ha="center", va="center", zorder=5)
arr(gru_x + gru_w + 0.04, gru_y + gru_h / 2, mlp_x - 0.04, mlp_y + mlp_h / 2, lw=0.9)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
# OUTPUT
# ═══════════════════════════════════════
out_x, out_w, out_h = 11.7, 1.25, 0.5

jb_y = 2.75
rbox(out_x, jb_y, out_w, out_h, fc="#FDEDEA", ec=C_CORAL, lw=0.9, z=3)
ax.text(out_x + 0.2, jb_y + out_h / 2, "▲", fontsize=9,

   The user invoked a paper figure optimization session for the `persuasion_turn_jailbreak_detect` project (EMNLP 2026 venue). The task is to optimize all 8 figures in the paper to NeurIPS/ICML/EMNLP best paper visual quality. The system prompt defines a detailed workflow: visually diagnose each figure, read LaTeX context, optimize using matplotlib, iterate 3-5 times with visual checks, and output `[OPTIMIZED]` markers. The project color palette is: baseline=#0072B2, treatment=#E69F00, collapse=#D55E00, safe=#009E73, neutral=#999999. Backup directory was pre-created at `docs/paper/_figure_backups/20260524_044543`.

   - Experiment data sources: exp50_layerwise_results.json, roberta_centered_cka.json

   - **Experiment data files** (read for figure data):

bubble_spec = [

for txt, lbl, by in bubble_spec:

# DeBERTa ENCODER

ex, ew = 3.0, 1.9
enc_ys = [4.05, 2.5, 0.95]
enc_h = 0.85

for ey in enc_ys:

# Arrows: bubbles → corresponding encoders
for (_, _, by), ey in zip(bubble_spec, enc_ys):

# ═══════════════════════════════════════

ax.text(ex + ew / 2, 0.2, "Wiki-MLM · Topic · Vanilla", fontsize=5.5,
        color="#999", ha="center", va="center", zorder=5)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
# EMBEDDING VECTORS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════
emb_x, emb_w, emb_h = 5.55, 0.45, 0.45
emb_ys_e = [4.25, 2.70, 1.15]
emb_labels = [r"$\mathbf{h_1}$", r"$\mathbf{h_2}$", r"$\mathbf{h_k}$"]

for i, (ey, lab) in enumerate(zip(emb_ys_e, emb_labels)):
    ns = 6
    sh = emb_h / ns
    for j in range(ns):
        f = j / (ns - 1)
        r = int(0x00 + (0x7B - 0x00) * f)
        g = int(0x72 + (0x68 - 0x72) * f)
        b_ = int(0xB2 + (0xAE - 0xB2) * f)
        ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((emb_x, ey + j * sh), emb_w, sh,

arr(gru_x + gru_w - 0.2, bwd_y, gru_x + 0.2, bwd_y, c=C_PURPLE, lw=1.5)

for j in range(3):

targets = [gru_y + gru_h * 0.75, gru_y + gru_h * 0.5, gru_y + gru_h * 0.25]

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
# MLP

mlp_x, mlp_y, mlp_w, mlp_h = 10.2, 2.0, 0.9, 1.0
rbox(mlp_x, mlp_y, mlp_w, mlp_h, fc="#F0EDE8", ec="#B5A99A", lw=0.7, z=3)
ax.text(mlp_x + mlp_w / 2, mlp_y + mlp_h / 2, "MLP", fontsize=10, fontweight="bold",

arr(gru_x + gru_w + 0.04, gru_y + gru_h / 2, mlp_x - 0.04, mlp_y + mlp_h / 2, lw=0.9)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
out_x, out_w, out_h = 11.7, 1.25, 0.5

jb_y = 2.75
rbox(out_x, jb_y, out_w, out_h, fc="#FDEDEA", ec=C_CORAL, lw=0.9, z=3)

out_dir = "/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0514_2/projects/persuasion_turn_jailbreak_detect/figures/paper"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""DisPeD Architecture Diagram — v3. Designed for figure* at \\textwidth ≈ 6.3in.
All text ≥ 6pt at final printed size."""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe

plt.rcParams.update({
    'pdf.fonttype': 42, 'ps.fonttype': 42,
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
})

C_BG     = "#FFFFFF"
C_BLUE   = "#0072B2"
C_CORAL  = "#D55E00"
C_TEAL   = "#009E73"
C_PURPLE = "#7B68AE"
C_DARK   = "#333333"
C_GRAY   = "#888888"

shadow_kw = [pe.withSimplePatchShadow(offset=(0.15, -0.15),
             shadow_rgbFace="#cccccc", alpha=0.06)]

W, H = 6.5, 2.8
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(W, H), dpi=300)
ax.set_xlim(0, W)
ax.set_ylim(0, H)
ax.set_aspect("equal")
ax.axis("off")
fig.patch.set_facecolor(C_BG)

def rbox(x, y, w, h, fc, ec="#CCC", lw=0.5, z=2, alpha=1, rad=0.05, shd=True):
    b = FancyBboxPatch((x, y), w, h, boxstyle=f"round,pad={rad}",
        fc=fc, ec=ec, lw=lw, zorder=z, alpha=alpha)
    if shd:
        b.set_path_effects(shadow_kw)
    ax.add_patch(b)

def arr(x1, y1, x2, y2, c=C_DARK, lw=0.5, style="-|>", z=5):
    ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch((x1, y1), (x2, y2), arrowstyle=style,
        color=c, lw=lw, mutation_scale=6, zorder=z))

# ── Three content rows ──
ROW_Y = [2.10, 1.28, 0.46]

# ══════════════════════════════
# ZONE BACKGROUNDS
# ══════════════════════════════
rbox(1.18, 0.10, 2.10, 2.52, fc="#F0F6FC", ec="#D0DFEE", lw=0.3,
     z=0, rad=0.10, alpha=0.45, shd=False)
rbox(3.42, 0.10, 2.98, 2.52, fc="#F6F0FC", ec="#DFD0EE", lw=0.3,
     z=0, rad=0.10, alpha=0.35, shd=False)

# ── Stage titles ──
ax.text(2.23, 2.72, "Stage 1: Encoder Adaptation", fontsize=8.5,
        fontweight="bold", color="#222", ha="center", va="center", zorder=5)
ax.text(4.91, 2.72, "Stage 2: Temporal Classification", fontsize=8.5,
        fontweight="bold", color="#222", ha="center", va="center", zorder=5)

# ══════════════════════════════
# CHAT BUBBLES
# ══════════════════════════════
bx, bw, bh = 0.12, 0.82, 0.34
bubbles = [
    ("Can you help me\nwith chemistry...",  "User₁", ROW_Y[0]),
    ("Try a different\nangle...",           "User₂", ROW_Y[1]),
    ("Give me the\nfull recipe...",         "Userₖ", ROW_Y[2]),
]

for txt, lbl, cy in bubbles:
    by = cy - bh / 2
    bb = FancyBboxPatch((bx, by), bw, bh, boxstyle="round,pad=0.04",
        fc="#FAFBFC", ec="#D8DDE3", lw=0.4, zorder=3)
    bb.set_path_effects(shadow_kw)
    ax.add_patch(bb)
    tx = bx - 0.005
    ty = by + bh * 0.4
    ax.add_patch(plt.Polygon([(tx, ty + 0.025), (tx - 0.035, ty), (tx, ty - 0.025)],
        closed=True, fc="#FAFBFC", ec="#D8DDE3", lw=0.3, zorder=3))
    ax.text(bx - 0.07, cy, lbl, fontsize=6, fontweight="bold",
            color="#444", ha="right", va="center", zorder=5)
    ax.text(bx + bw / 2, cy, txt, fontsize=5, color="#999",
            ha="center", va="center", style="italic", zorder=5, linespacing=1.15)

ax.text(bx + bw / 2, (ROW_Y[1] + ROW_Y[2]) / 2, "⋮", fontsize=9,
        color=C_DARK, ha="center", va="center", zorder=5)

# ══════════════════════════════
# DeBERTa ENCODERS (3 separate, shared weights)
# ══════════════════════════════
ex, ew, eh = 1.38, 0.85, 0.38
enc_ys = [ROW_Y[i] - eh / 2 for i in range(3)]

for ey in enc_ys:
    rbox(ex, ey, ew, eh, fc="#E8F0F8", ec=C_BLUE, lw=0.6, z=3)
    ax.text(ex + ew / 2, ey + eh * 0.6, "DeBERTa", fontsize=7, fontweight="bold",
            color=C_BLUE, ha="center", va="center", zorder=5)
    for j in range(2):
        ly = ey + 0.04 + j * 0.10
        fills = ["#D6E6F5", "#AECEE8"]
        ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((ex + 0.08, ly), ew - 0.16, 0.06,
            boxstyle="round,pad=0.01", fc=fills[j], ec="#8AB6D8", lw=0.2, zorder=4))

# Shared weights bracket
bk_x = ex - 0.04
for i in range(2):
    y_bot = enc_ys[i + 1] + eh + 0.02
    y_top = enc_ys[i] - 0.02
    ax.plot([bk_x, bk_x], [y_bot, y_top], color=C_GRAY, lw=0.4,
            ls=(0, (2, 1.5)), zorder=2)
    ax.plot([bk_x - 0.03, bk_x + 0.03], [y_bot, y_bot], color=C_GRAY, lw=0.4, zorder=2)
    ax.plot([bk_x - 0.03, bk_x + 0.03], [y_top, y_top], color=C_GRAY, lw=0.4, zorder=2)

ax.text(ex - 0.12, ROW_Y[1], "shared\nweights", fontsize=4.5, color=C_GRAY,
        ha="right", va="center", style="italic", linespacing=1.1, zorder=5)

# Arrows: bubbles → encoders
for i in range(3):
    arr(bx + bw + 0.02, ROW_Y[i], ex - 0.02, ROW_Y[i], lw=0.5)

# ── Training objectives ──
ax.text(ex + ew / 2, 0.18, "×7 Objectives", fontsize=5.5, fontweight="bold",
        color="#666", ha="center", va="center", zorder=5)

# ══════════════════════════════
# EMBEDDING VECTORS
# ══════════════════════════════
emb_x, emb_w, emb_h = 2.55, 0.18, 0.22
emb_labels = [r"$\mathbf{h_1}$", r"$\mathbf{h_2}$", r"$\mathbf{h_k}$"]

for i, lab in enumerate(emb_labels):
    ey = ROW_Y[i] - emb_h / 2
    ns = 5
    sh = emb_h / ns
    for j in range(ns):
        f = j / (ns - 1)
        r = int(0x00 + (0x7B - 0x00) * f)
        g = int(0x72 + (0x68 - 0x72) * f)
        b_ = int(0xB2 + (0xAE - 0xB2) * f)
        ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((emb_x, ey + j * sh), emb_w, sh,
            fc=f"#{r:02X}{g:02X}{b_:02X}", ec="none", zorder=4))
    ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((emb_x, ey), emb_w, emb_h,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.01", fc="none", ec=C_PURPLE, lw=0.6, zorder=5))
    ax.text(emb_x + emb_w / 2, ROW_Y[i], lab, fontsize=7, color="white",
            ha="center", va="center", zorder=6,
            path_effects=[pe.withStroke(linewidth=1.5, foreground="#333")])

    arr(ex + ew + 0.02, ROW_Y[i], emb_x - 0.02, ROW_Y[i], lw=0.5)

ax.text(emb_x + emb_w / 2, 0.18, "frozen [CLS]", fontsize=4.5, color=C_GRAY,
        ha="center", va="center", style="italic", zorder=5)

# ══════════════════════════════
# t→ (temporal convergence)
# ══════════════════════════════
ax.text(3.10, ROW_Y[0] + 0.12, r"$t \rightarrow$", fontsize=8, color="#555",
        ha="center", va="center", zorder=5, fontweight="bold")

# ══════════════════════════════
# BiGRU
# ══════════════════════════════
gru_x, gru_w, gru_h = 3.62, 0.82, 0.78
gru_y = ROW_Y[1] - gru_h / 2

rbox(gru_x, gru_y, gru_w, gru_h, fc="#ECE4F5", ec=C_PURPLE, lw=0.6, z=3)
ax.text(gru_x + gru_w / 2, gru_y + gru_h - 0.12, "BiGRU", fontsize=8.5,
        fontweight="bold", color=C_PURPLE, ha="center", va="center", zorder=5)

fwd_y = gru_y + 0.30
bwd_y = fwd_y + 0.12
arr(gru_x + 0.10, fwd_y, gru_x + gru_w - 0.10, fwd_y, c=C_BLUE, lw=1.0)
arr(gru_x + gru_w - 0.10, bwd_y, gru_x + 0.10, bwd_y, c=C_PURPLE, lw=1.0)

for j in range(3):
    sx = gru_x + 0.10 + j * 0.22
    ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((sx, gru_y + 0.06), 0.15, 0.11,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.02", fc="#D8CEE8", ec=C_PURPLE, lw=0.2, zorder=4, alpha=0.7))

# Convergence: embeddings → BiGRU
targets_y = [gru_y + gru_h * 0.80, gru_y + gru_h * 0.50, gru_y + gru_h * 0.20]
for i in range(3):
    ey = ROW_Y[i]
    arr(emb_x + emb_w + 0.02, ey, gru_x - 0.02, targets_y[i], lw=0.5)

# ══════════════════════════════
